PC: Perform initial primary survey (ABCDE: airway, breathing, circulation, disability, exposure)
Perform initial evaluation and stabilization of a patient with cyanosis (signifying hypoxia) and respiratory distress
Stabilize a neonate with central cyanosis and hypoxia
Perform secondary survey and recognize potential lidocaine exposure as part of SAMPLE history
MK: Evaluate central cyanosis and hypoxia in a neonate
Recognize signs and symptoms of methemoglobinemia
ICS: Communicate openly with the parent even if there is uncertainty
Perform as part of an effective team
